items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: Such men like Jack Teagarden, the general, all them warholms.

ctx.x: King, you know. King, you know. King, you know. King, you know. When Lewis hit that number, he had five trumpets, all back there. Five. And all them guys could play trumpets too. Oh, yeah, yeah. When Lewis made the first bar, first bar, first bar. The man caught his key, yeah. I said, I hit it. I said, get in there. Come on, get in there. Boy, them, and they got, like, wild, like wild, we saw you. Boy, them trompetors, saw you.

Such men like Jack Teagarden, the general, all them warholms. He's telling the truth on that bar. You see how it happened. You see how it happened. We had five bands at Disneyland. They call it a river parade. They put all the bands on board. And then when we come down. .
